Container.Name: OrlaNumis
Container.Overview: Orla Numis catalogues a personal collection of coins and banknotes: records with photos and catalogue references (KM, Pick, Numista), Numista lookups and values, sets and challenges such as the euro commemoratives, statistics, a wish list, duplicates to trade, PDF and Excel exports, a full backup every day, and optional AI tools (Anthropic Claude or a self-hosted Ollama). In English and European Portuguese. The first account registered becomes the administrator; Admin, Updates tells when a new version is out.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: coins banknotes numismatics numista collection catalogue moedas notas
Container.Requires: Optional: a Numista API key for catalogue lookups, and an Anthropic API key or an Ollama server for the AI features.
Container.Changes: The notes of each version are in the changelog: https://github.com/AnaGermano6/OrlaNumis/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: The full backups, made every day. A folder on another share keeps them apart from appdata.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the files (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the files (100 is users).

Config.Name: AI agent
Config.Description: off leaves the AI agent out, and with it the AI features; without AI set up, off saves its memory and processor time.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy: its address (for example 172.18.0.1/32), so sign-in protection sees the real client. none without one.
